g.title: RoatheRank3Convo3 begins.
g.text: RoatheRank3Convo3 begins.

g.title: j3791167673
g.text: Evaluate expressions on HellStory counter

g.title: j186013759
g.text: It pulls at me, day and night. This constant nagging knowledge that not only did I trust you with all my deepest secrets, not only did you betray that trust and took all that away from me and now I cannot remember why...

g.title: j1008275605
g.text: We are making good progress in overturning these stones in my mind. Albrecht did quite the number on me when he injected that serum.

g.title: j1086835156
g.text: You are flagging in your progress in helping me uncover my memories. If you expect to uphold your end of the bargain, I expect you to continue your work in the Descendia.

g.title: j1408240450
g.text: You have yet to make any progress in the Descendia in uncovering my memories. If you wish me to hold up my end of the bargain, you should work toward holding up yours.

g.title: j3791167673->j1408240450
g.text: false

g.title: j1787026705
g.text: Check boolean RoatheResetForgiven

g.title: j3608779839
g.text: They don't seem pleasant.

g.title: j1129108608
g.text: They don't seem pleasant. Are you sure we should keep going?

g.title: j242691715
g.text: [End.]

g.title: j564529174
g.text: I've been kind of struggling with it, honestly... I keep dying, no matter how hard I try.

g.title: j4090739092
g.text: I don't take orders from you, Roathe.

g.title: j3302326615
g.text: I've been busy. I'll get on it.

g.title: j383676388
g.text: Not only have I forgiven you for the act of taking those memories away from me...

g.title: j1787026705->j383676388
g.text: true

g.title: j3248066204
g.text: Not only am I starting to forgive you for the act of taking those memories away from me...

g.title: j1787026705->j3248066204
g.text: false

g.title: j2284937720
g.text: No. They are not. What were you expecting from the "Devil of Tau," memories of a sunny afternoon in the park, reclining on a blanket and eating grapes from platter?

g.title: j2878845638
g.text: I will not know what he took from me until I have it all back. Of course we should keep going! Those memories are mine, Drifter. They make up who I am, who I was. They are they very fabric of my being.

g.title: Chat ends.
g.text: Chat ends.

g.title: j1791190840
g.text: Boolean RoatheStrugglebus is now true.

g.title: j3621421837
g.text: No, you do not. And it makes no difference to me what you do with your day. I am merely saying that if you want that scrawny little butler to walk up those stairs, you have a job to do.

g.title: j2324347544
g.text: See that you do. It makes no difference to me what you do with your day. I am merely saying that if you want that scrawny little butler to walk up those stairs, you have a job to do.

g.title: j1687151366
g.text: But I am starting to find myself wishing to trust you again. Again! Knowing full well what you have done. Knowing you are liable to simply betray me once more!

g.title: j469465199
g.text: My poor Usurper, I fear what we are going to find buried in the annals of my mind will be only blood, gore, and failure.

g.title: j1847486354
g.text: From what I have gleaned from the others regarding your time in Duviri, you were once similarly afflicted, were you not?

g.title: j1956144463
g.text: I hear nothing but tales of you overcoming the Narmer. Defeating hordes of Grineer soldiers. Defeating waves of Murmur at every turn. Yet I have managed to confound you?

g.title: j3119801435
g.text: If you do not care? Then neither do I. I have my own matters to attend.

g.title: j1570470371
g.text: If you do not care? Then neither do I. I have my own matters to attend.

g.title: j4292793347
g.text: But I find myself sitting in that crypt and I stand from that chair and I think to myself "I wonder if Drifter is about and if they wish to speak."

g.title: j2440263466
g.text: You're piloting this ship. If you want to keep sailing it into the black hole, full speed ahead.

g.title: j2444460960
g.text: Are you sure you want to keep going, then?

g.title: j1993295470
g.text: We are very different people, Roathe.

g.title: j2663957459
g.text: I was. Memory and apathy. I still can't remember... whole chunks of time, there.

g.title: j2591855542
g.text: +20 Chemistry

g.title: j1933300832
g.text: +10 Chemistry

g.title: j431736655
g.text: How utterly pathetic is that? How low have I been brought? Me?! An Orokin?! Roathe! The Devil of Tau! So restless, so intellectually starved, so desperate for any kind of stimulation that I am here, speaking with you!

g.title: j3465940725
g.text: +10 Chemistry

g.title: j2877557226
g.text: I will not know what he took from me until I have it all back. Of course we should keep going! Those memories are mine, Drifter. They make up who I am, who I was. They are the very fabric of my being.

g.title: j1848582429
g.text: That may be, but it was hardly the point I was making. Which you are avoiding having to concede. Very well. If, in theory, you had lost memories - would you seek to regain them if you could?

g.title: j1930680638
g.text: If you had the opportunity to regain your lost memories, would you?

g.title: j2569215263
g.text: Assuming that you are not lying to me? I admit that is rather flattering. Adorable. Extremely sad. But flattering.

g.title: j3503329849
g.text: I look forward to our conversations, whether you do or not.

g.title: j708943315
g.text: I'll try not to take that personally.

g.title: j2392392227
g.text: Or, you just enjoy talking to me?

g.title: j539438309
g.text: Well said, Drifter. I will not know the magnitude of what was taken from me until I have it all back. Those memories make up who I am, who I was. They are the very fabric of my being.

g.title: j3849144227
g.text: I think it's better to know than to not know, but... we have to be prepared for it.

g.title: j3191988413
g.text: Sometimes I think things should stay buried for a reason.

g.title: j1600271057
g.text: You're right. I would. It's time for us to go get it. How bad could it be? You're an Orokin, you've done worse things, certainly.

g.title: j3742122688
g.text: Then I am so terribly glad I was not rendered unto a drooling idiot when you muddled about in my skull with a fork.

g.title: j4163732577
g.text: Perhaps you should. You were the one who muddled about in my skull with a fork, after all.

g.title: j1733946112
g.text: Perhaps I would, if I did not know you had muddled about in my skull with a fork.

g.title: j1119482623
g.text: It's yours. It's time for us to go get it. How bad could it be? You're an Orokin, you've done worse things, certainly.

g.title: j357416102
g.text: Prepared, precisely, how? Do you believe I will collapse like some feeble house of cards once I learn the terrible truth of some grotesque war crime?

g.title: j1236212642
g.text: Are we not then doomed to repeat our previous mistakes? Never learning, never evolving, forever living in blissful ignorance of our former selves?

g.title: j2544281724
g.text: +10 Chemistry

g.title: j3284677091
g.text: Check boolean RoatheResetForgiven

g.title: j3522054777
g.text: Believe me, I can imagine every possible thing I could have done to the Sentients, Orokin, or any combination thereof and there is little that would render me shocked or horrified.

g.title: j927250906
g.text: Hm. I may have just made a case against my own argument for most people, I realize.

g.title: j4122235045
g.text: Hear, hear! I will hardly collapse like some feeble house of cards once I learn the terrible truth of some grotesque war crime.

g.title: j1543845048
g.text: I said I forgave you. And I am attempting to adhere to that which I promised you. It is simply that words do not sometimes make a thing true. And saying one forgives someone is very nice in theory but sometimes emotions have a hard time following fact.

g.title: j3284677091->j1543845048
g.text: true

g.title: j2379146107
g.text: Really, this is all quite irritating. I want to converse with you. But I also want to throttle you for having befouled my mind.

g.title: j3284677091->j2379146107
g.text: false

g.title: j3899333187
g.text: Add 1 to Thermostat counter

g.title: j3686421624
g.text: Add -1 to Thermostat counter

g.title: j2180341279
g.text: Add -2 to Thermostat counter

g.title: j941062748
g.text: I understand. It's a hard thing to accept, and you might want to, but can't.

g.title: j647070326
g.text: So you... don't forgive me?

g.title: j2249224829
g.text: You're going to just have to accept what happened and move on, Roathe.

g.title: j2021831508
g.text: Do you think you can ever forgive me?

g.title: j3813322698
g.text: I can remember enough to know that I could ask for "forgiveness" at the altar of the Luminaries for the next two thousand years and have it never granted.

g.title: j3051867445
g.text: I would prefer to learn all the facts myself and judge the situation from there.

g.title: j3761865398
g.text: I can imagine every possible thing I could have done to the Sentients, Orokin, or any combination thereof and there is little that would render me shocked or horrified.

g.title: j579865239
g.text: I am trying my damnable and level best, Usurper. For there is something about you that has captured my attention. You are fascinating. And that is a rare thing in my world.

g.title: j1671606992
g.text: Mmhm.

g.title: j2455035813
g.text: Boolean RoatheResetForgiven is now true.

g.title: j3112137732
g.text: No, what is waiting for me at the bottom of my mind does not scare me. I merely wish to reclaim that which was wrongfully taken from me.

g.title: j3890496142
g.text: No, what is waiting for me at the bottom of my mind does not scare me. I merely wish to reclaim that which was wrongfully taken from me.

g.title: j2530781974
g.text: So be patient with me, if you can, while I try to reconcile all this.

g.title: j362494054
g.text: +10 Chemistry

g.title: j509609570
g.text: As you said. It is time for us to retake that which is mine.

g.title: j3172473025
g.text: I will.

g.title: j2307305705
g.text: I'm the one who should be asking for patience from you, Roathe. Not the other way around.

g.title: j2865491717
g.text: But I appreciate the concern, nonetheless.

g.title: j2462580690
g.text: How kind of you.

g.title: j608565229
g.text: +20 Chemistry

g.title: j4081414586
g.text: +5 Chemistry

g.title: j4073329753
g.text: That recognition is appreciated.
